name: 546-session-root-probe-copy-consumer-path
note: #546: minimized from the issue's recorded shape (the raw captures are not in the worktree; every absolute path is replaced by a placeholder). On a consumer run (pluginRoot set, no probeRunPath, sessionRoot another directory than the worktree) the probe agent mis-copied the session-root command (it also appended the digest flag to the typed text), probe-run.cjs refused it against --expect-cmd (exit -1, empty-output digest, cmd= the digest of refused:<typed text>, stderr expect-cmd-mismatch), and the fresh-agent retry (#486) failed the same way. The run ends provision-failed with probeReason command-not-run. The avoided-copy change (the command no longer carries the plugin path; the gate exports LGTMGATE_TEMPLATES) is proven by T546a and the [546] probe-run checks, not by this replay.

args.brief: a mis-copied session-root probe command on a consumer run must end as command-not-run with the refusal cause in the result
